plugins.name: fable-advisor
plugins.description: Architect-as-orchestrator: your session runs a flagship-tier Claude model that writes delivery contracts and verdicts, while a Grok-family lane (Grok CLI) and a GPT-family lane (Codex; currently GPT-6 Astra) own the implementation within them — with an in-house Claude lane when neither CLI is installed, and a commitment-boundary advisor.
